post.description:
Create an account. With a matching `invite_token` the email counts as verified and the membership is
created; otherwise a verification email is sent.
Rotate the `pv_refresh` cookie. `{org_id}` switches the active org (must be a member, else 403).
Always 202, whether or not the account exists. The link is valid 30 min.
Sets the password and revokes every refresh token of the user. Expired/used -> 410 TOKEN_EXPIRED.

get.description: 302 to Google with state + nonce + PKCE (S256); the pending request rides in an HttpOnly cookie.

302 to `{web}/auth/callback#status=ok&new_user=…&return_to=…` with the refresh cookie set, or
`#error=<ErrorCode>`. The web then calls POST /auth/refresh to get the Session.

post.description:
SCR-40 P03 (under /auth so the refresh cookie identifies this browser). Wrong current password → 401
INVALID_CREDENTIALS. Signs out every other session.
SCR-40 P04: sign out of all other sessions (this browser stays signed in).

delete.description:
SCR-40 D03: `confirm_email` must be the account's email (422). 409 LAST_OWNER while you are the only owner
of an org with other members; orgs with no other member are deleted too. Clears the refresh cookie.

patch.description: SCR-40 P01 name, R03 email notifications (`email_prefs`, partial).

delete.description: Deletes the account if its email is not verified yet (409 CONFLICT otherwise) and clears the cookie.

get.description: DLG-08: orgs that block deleting the account, and orgs that would be deleted with it.

post.description:
Creator becomes owner (verified email required: 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED). POST /auth/refresh
`{org_id}` afterwards to get a token for it.

delete.description:
SCR-40 D04 / DLG-08, owner only: `confirm_name` must equal the org's name (422 otherwise). Members lose
access at once; videos, results and files in the org's region are purged within 24 h.

patch.description: Admin+; only owners grant/revoke `owner`; the last owner cannot be demoted (409 LAST_OWNER).

delete.description: Admin+ (or yourself, to leave); same last-owner rule.

post.description:
Admin+; 7-day links. Emails that are already members are skipped; a pending invite to the same email
is replaced (old link stops working).

SCR-41 while billing is not live: join the waitlist for a plan. Any member; a non-owner's request emails
the owners (E07 "Notify owner").

get.description: Public. Unknown/revoked -> 404; accepted or past expiry -> `expired: true`.

post.description:
Joins the org and returns a Session whose active org is the invited one.
Wrong account -> 403 INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH; expired/used -> 410 TOKEN_EXPIRED; unknown/revoked -> 404.

What DELETE /me would do: ``blocking`` orgs need another owner first (you are their only owner and they have
other members); ``deleted_with_account`` orgs have no other member and are deleted with the account.
